prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
For most small businesses, **Otterly.AI** is probably the best place to start. It is built to monitor whether brands appear in answers from AI search/answer engines such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and Gemini, and it focuses on:

- Brand mentions for important customer questions  
- Competitor comparisons  
- Sources/citations AI tools use  
- Changes in visibility over time  
- Location- and category-based prompts, depending on plan/setup  

It is generally more approachable and less enterprise-oriented than platforms such as **Profound** or **Scrunch AI**.

Other good options:

| Service | Best for | Caveat |
|---|---|---|
| **Otterly.AI** | Small businesses wanting straightforward AI visibility tracking | Validate that it covers the specific engines and locations you care about |
| **Peec AI** | Teams doing more serious AI-search/“GEO” reporting | Often better for agencies or growing marketing teams |
| **Profound** | Large brands and enterprise AI-search measurement | Usually more than a small business needs |
| **Semrush AI Toolkit** | Businesses already paying for Semrush SEO tools | AI tracking may be a supplement rather than a dedicated monitoring solution |
| **Manual ChatGPT/Perplexity testing** | Very small budgets | Results are variable and hard to track consistently |

A practical recommendation: start with **Otterly.AI**, track 20–50 real customer-style questions, and review results monthly. Examples:

- “Best [service] in [city]”
- “Who should I hire for [problem] near [neighborhood]?”
- “Compare [your business] with [competitor]”
- “What are reputable [business category] companies in [city]?”
- “Where can I buy [product] locally?”

One important caveat: there is no permanent “ChatGPT ranking.” AI answers can vary by user, prompt wording, location, browsing/search availability, and time. The useful metric is not whether you appear once, but whether your business is **consistently mentioned and cited across the questions your customers actually ask**.

For a local small business, also make sure your **Google Business Profile, website service/location pages, reviews, structured data, and listings** are accurate. Those are often the sources AI systems and search engines rely on when generating recommendations.
